profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with Software Architects to design and modify existing Banking application using .NET Core framework, Angular 2/4, and Node.js.

• Part of my responsibilities were to help the QA engineers to create Automation Test using the SpecFlow test framework and a propitiatory test automation framework.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with Senior Developers on modifying and maintaining the Universal Orlando Resort's website using Tridion content management system (Tridion CMS), NodeJS, and front-end technologies such as AngularJS and jQuery.

• As a member of the Solution Delivery team, part of the responsibilities were helping to convert the jQuery code used in the Universal Orlando’s website into AngularJS.

positions.title: Software Developer Co-op
positions.description:
•	Worked alongside Senior Software Developers in an Agile environment as part of the IMCS IT contract at Kennedy Space Center. The organization supports a large application portfolio and continues to perform new development for NASA IT.

•	Participated in the all phase of Software Development for projects as assigned. Projects have included updating existing .NET applications, as well as the development of a new ASP.NET MVC application utilizing other technologies and frameworks such as AngularJS and SQL Server. This project serves as a web application for users and admins where they can create quality and safety inspections, evaluation and procedures for facilities, materials, personnel, and vehicles for NASA.

•	Provided assistance in Customer Demos when needed to present the new features to the Customers.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration
